name: rolling-number
title: Rolling number
description: A number whose digits roll to the new value when it changes. Screen readers read the final value.
a11y: The animated digits are aria-hidden; the formatted final value is plain text for screen readers.
With prefers-reduced-motion the digits change without rolling.
